content: here it tells me to use leanproject CLI tool, but there are no instructions for doing that on website. Any ideas? I just want to build the sphinx files from source to get a PDF :)
That repo is about Lean 3 so completely out of date (leanproject is a lean 3 tool). You want https://github.com/leanprover/theorem_proving_in_lean4

Kevin Buzzard said:

No problem! The community has been actively putting "This is Lean 3, please click here for the Lean 4 version" banners in lots of places but I agree that there is very little indication on that repo that it's outdated. @Jeremy Avigad are you the person to ping about this? https://github.com/leanprover/theorem_proving_in_lean/pull/123
It looks like @Marc Huisinga merged it. Thank you to you both for taking case of this.
